skillFull: Destroys obstacles at certain intervals by pecking at them with its needle beak. While pecking, Choco Bonbon Jellies are created. After a certain amount of pecks, the obstacle is destroyed. Level Up for more points for Choco Bonbon Jellies.
story: As Chocolate Bonbon Cookie's trusty helper, Bonbon Birdy takes care of everything to the very sewing of the outfits for the fashion shows. Rumor has it the sharp Needle Beak has never once missed the mark! That combined with speeds surpassing even the most experienced designer Cookies, it's no wonder Chocolate Bonbon Cookie keeps entrusting this companion with work!

costumes.info: "This year's Fall & Winter collection features A.C.i.D.'s main hip colors that sing vibrancy. Not yelling, singing!
